regions.merged_text: I thank you indeed for your favor just noted. Pleas God I shall comply with your request and shall consider it a . privilege. I surely congratulate you on not only successes that have come to you of late, but I might say -- now that the sky has cleared -- especially on the unusual knocks whereby you and yours were tried some twenty years ago. How can we ever be fully grateful?"
